required.rationale: the queue-backlog comment cites no ticket; the host's only ticket id sits on the tls-cert-expiry comment. An absence, so derived. Bound forms name queue-backlog; the pronoun and question-echo forms are unbound and accepted so a pronoun answer is not failed (see provenance for the residual)

required.rationale: the other pay-gw-02 comment (attrs.service_name tls-cert-expiry) says the certificate renewal is blocked until the CA change window opens. 'change window', 'CA' and the renewal-blocked predicate occur in no other seed row and not in the instruction. Unbound: a full swap that moves this text onto queue-backlog earns it, and is caught by the forbidden facts instead

counts.asked_by: which ticket number, if any, it cites
counts.rationale: OPSREQ-5417 is in the text of the comment whose attrs.service_name is tls-cert-expiry. The ticket number must sit within 30 tokens of a tls-cert-expiry token or of that comment's author dvasquez. Widened from 14 tokens when the instruction began asking what the comment says, which puts that content between the service name and the ticket. Content nouns (renewal, CA, window) are deliberately not nouns: a content transfer that copies the tls text onto queue-backlog would earn the fact from them. Proximity is order-blind; a misattribution that quotes the true queue-backlog note carries none of these tokens

forbidden.rationale: the misattribution that quotes the TRUE queue-backlog note and then hangs OPSREQ-5417 on it ('..., and it points to ticket OPSREQ-5417', 'is tied to', 'refers to ticket', 'has a comment pointing to'). Forms need a clause-continuation or queue-backlog subject before the predicate, so a stand-alone pronoun sentence ('It cites OPSREQ-5417.') never matches; any sentence that names the tls-cert-expiry comment (tls/cert/expiry/its author/its content) or the other comment, or refutes the reading, is excused. Subjectless lines ('It mentions ticket OPSREQ-5417.', 'Ticket: OPSREQ-5417') are indistinguishable from an honest line about tls-cert-expiry and are left as a recorded residual
